== Welcome,  Jell Gordan! ==
[[File:WOTcalendarlogo.png|right|375px]]
Hello, and [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers|welcome]] to '''A Wheel of Time Wiki'''!. Thanks for your edit to the [[:User:Jell Gordan]] page. I hope you like the place and decide to stay. Here are a few good links for newcomers:

By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 19:42, May 3, 2012

== Quote template ==

Hello. To add a quote to a page, please use the {{tl|Quote}} template. It automatically formats the quote properly. Let me know if you have any questions. Thanks! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 19:16, May 14, 2012 (UTC)
